Springfield Fall 2026 swim lessons open Tuesday, September 15 at 7:00 a.m., and I'll be ready for Max and Mia. Residents get first access that day, and the general public opens 7 days later. Max fits the age band for this session. Mia is just outside it, so please check she fits Springfield's age range before you sign her up. Registration page: https://rec.example.org/springfield/fall-2026

Here is what I'll send you before it opens. A week ahead, I'll remind you of the date. Three days ahead, I'll send a checklist. The evening before, I'll send a last reminder. And 15 minutes before it opens, I'll send a final text with the page link. I never register for you. Once you've picked a course, send me its page link and the morning text will include it.
